attempts.text:
Harsh Yadav 
                         +91 8737811439   |    harsh122hy@gmail.com   |   linkedin.com/in/harsh-yadav-404a9a356 

 
Profile  
Information Technology graduate aspiring to build a career as an IT Desktop Support Engineer. Possess 
knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals and troubleshooting 
concepts. Hands-on experience with AWS fundamentals and keen interest in building expertise in IT 
infrastructure and cloud technologies. 

Technical Skills 
OS:                                  Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2022/2025, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (Basic) 
Networking:                   TCP/IP, IP Addressing, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi Troubleshooting,  
                                         Ping, Tracert 
User Administration:    Active Directory, Password Reset, Outlook Configuration, MS Office, Office 365 
Support:                         Remote Desktop (RDP), Printer Configuration, Hardware & Software  
                                        Troubleshooting 
Hardware:                      PC Assembly, Component Installation, Hardware Configuration & Upgrades 
Tools:                              Event Viewer, Task Manager, Ticket Handling, System Monitoring, Documentation 
Cloud:                             AWS EC2, S3, IAM, VPC   
 

Hands-On Practice 
 Installed and configured Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2022/2025 and Red Hat Enterprise Linux virtual 

machines using VMware 
 Configured TCP/IP settings and tested connectivity using Ping and Tracert. 
 Performed hardware and software troubleshooting. 
 Installed device drivers and configured printers. 
 Practiced Active Directory, DNS and DHCP concepts. 
 

Experience 
Evo Technology                                                                                                                     Aug 2025  Present 
Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 
Desktop Support Engineer 
 
 Troubleshooting of Desktop. 
 Installing Microsoft Operating System updating and maintenance. 
 Configure and troubleshooting of MS Outlook 2019. 
 Performed general maintenance tasks on Computers, Laptops, Printers and other authorized network 

equipment. 
 Basic LAN/WAN connectivity and internet troubleshooting. 
 Solve internet related problems configuring basic TCP/IP settings. 
 Solving laptop issues through Remote Support. 
 Creating & Managing user accounts through domain & workgroup. 

 

Education 
Bachelor of Technology (Information Technology)                                        2020  2024 
Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam Technical University 
 
Senior Secondary Education                                                                                        2019 
Maharaja Agrasen Public School, Lucknow 
 
Secondary Education                                                                                                     2017 
Maharaja Agrasen Public School, Lucknow
